description: This file contains the implementation of the GetOrderDetailsHandler class, which handles the retrieval of order details by implementing MediatR's IRequestHandler interface. It uses a repository pattern to fetch order information, constructs a view model with order data, and returns it asynchronously.

classes.name: GetOrderDetailsHandler
classes.description: Handler class that processes GetOrderDetails requests to fetch and assemble order details into a view model.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Asynchronously handles request to get order details, querying the repository with a specification, and returning a populated OrderDetailViewModel or null if not found.
